entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about an order I placed a while back. I need to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered on October 31st. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a preference issue?
It's a fit issue. I've used them on a few rides, but no matter how I adjust the cleats or what socks I wear, they're giving me terrible blisters on my heels. They just don't work for my foot shape.
I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely no fun and can ruin a ride. It sounds like you've tried to make them work. Let me check the return eligibility for you.
Thanks. I'm hoping we can work something out. I know it's been over a month.

Okay, I've reviewed your order and our policy. It looks like your purchase is still well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you once we receive the shoes back.

Oh, that's great news. I appreciate that. Now, since I'll have to pay to ship these back and I'm out a pair of shoes, is there any chance you could offer a small credit or a discount code for my next VeloFit purchase?

I understand the request. While our policy allows for the full refund on the item itself, we don't typically offer additional credits for fit-related returns. The good news is that I can issue you a pre-paid return label, so you won't have any out-of-pocket shipping costs.
A pre-paid label works. That's a fair solution. So, you'll email that to me and I just send the shoes back for the full refund?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with the shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Once our warehouse receives and inspects the item, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that covers it. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
